facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports Malawi launched its web-based Land Information Management System in February 2024, where registered users submit documents, receive notifications and pay ground rent and application fees, while some transactions remain manual.
The Ministry of Lands is reviewing LIMS workflows and developing digital procedures to move the remaining manual land transactions onto the platform, per a ministry deputy director of LIMS.
ITWeb Africa says the web-based LIMS is designed to link processes and data across the Lands, Surveys and Physical Planning departments and other stakeholders.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development
